residual_risks.title: No project-level CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md found
residual_risks.detail: No standards files exist at any ancestor directory of the changed files (only node_modules copies were located). All pattern observations below are inferred from sibling connector code, not written rules, and cannot be elevated to findings.

residual_risks.title: New connector uses native fetch + dataforseo-client SDK instead of fetchJsonWithRetry
residual_risks.detail: All three existing BYO connectors (exa_byo.ts, perigon_byo.ts, twitter_byo.ts) route HTTP calls through fetchJsonWithRetry from ./common/http. dataforseo_serp_byo.ts takes a fetchImpl: typeof fetch parameter and uses the dataforseo-client SDK directly. No written rule prohibits this, but it means retry/timeout behaviour differs across connectors with no policy enforcement.

residual_risks.title: SMOKE_TEST_SERP_INPUTS exported from production job file
residual_risks.detail: ingest_byo.ts exports SMOKE_TEST_SERP_INPUTS as a named export. All other connectors inject test data only via the deps parameter in tests. Exporting a hardcoded fixture from the production scheduler is a pattern deviation. No written rule to cite; flagged as drift.

residual_risks.title: COST_PER_CALL sentinel value of 0 for dataforseo_serp_byo may silently disable spend enforcement
residual_risks.detail: The diff sets dataforseo_serp_byo cost to 0 as a sentinel with a comment referencing R17 telemetry. If any upstream logic compares cost > 0 to enable budget checks, the connector will never be blocked on spend. No written rule to evaluate; risk is unverifiable without reading spend enforcement code.

testing_gaps.title: entity_route.ts has no corresponding test file in the diff
testing_gaps.detail: apps/api/src/runtime/entity_route.ts is added as a new file but no test file for it appears in the diff or in apps/api/tests/. All other changed files have accompanying tests (dataforseo_serp_byo.test.ts, serp_query_builder already covered in tests/). Cannot confirm whether an entity_route test exists outside the diff.
